svg.title: Turn a library prompt into a practice task
svg.desc: Each prompt belongs to a task, a tool and a chapter with checks. Find the task. Pick a card for the work you need to do. Adapt the input. Replace the fictional sample with suitable practice data. Check the result. Open the linked chapter and follow its checks.
svg.text: Turn a library prompt into a practice task
Each prompt belongs to a task, a tool and a chapter with checks.
Pick a card for the work you need to do.
Replace the fictional sample with suitable practice data.
Open the linked chapter and follow its checks.
